<!--
Thanks for proposing an idea. For anything non-trivial, opening an
issue first lets us discuss fit, scope, and architectural implications
before you (or anyone) invests effort in a PR.

If you're using coldpress-os inside a project, the `propose-change`
skill can generate a well-structured proposal for you:

  > Run the propose-change skill

You can then paste the output below.
-->

## Problem or opportunity

<!--
What is the user or developer actually trying to do? What is painful,
missing, or awkward about the current framework? Focus on the problem
before jumping to a solution.
-->

## Proposed approach

<!--
Your suggestion for how to address it. A rough sketch is fine — we can
iterate on specifics together.
-->

## Alternatives considered

<!--
Other ways to solve the same problem. Describe at least one alternative
and why the proposed approach is preferable. If you considered doing
nothing, say so.
-->

## Scope and impact

- **New skills / agents / workflows affected:**
- **Sacred documents affected** (context.md, tech-stack.md, PRD,
  architecture.md, PERT — see CONTRIBUTING.md): <!-- yes / no, which -->
- **Breaking change?** <!-- yes / no -->
- **Stack-pack-specific, or framework-wide?**

## Acceptance criteria

<!--
What would done look like? How would a reviewer verify the proposal
has been implemented successfully?
-->

- [ ]
- [ ]
